subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
object: knock off all balls in 55 seconds
text: Gotta Collect 'Em All requires knocking off all the balls in 55 seconds with 35 seconds or more left on the clock.

evidence.quote: Knocking off all the balls in 55 seconds (35 seconds or more left on the clock) is quite the challenge.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: The commenter says the achievement must be executed efficiently from start to finish.

evidence.quote: You really need to be efficient from start to finish.

subject: Gotta Collect 'Em All
text: The arm hitbox can be surprising when collecting balls, but the commenter says the achievement is doable.

evidence.quote: First time you do it, you might think "how is possible?" or you won't believe the hit box of your arms in collecting the balls at times. But it is doable.

subject: Aggro Crag
text: On Advanced difficulty, the commenter advises taking your time on the Aggro Crag because some parts ahead are off-screen and cannot be seen.

evidence.quote: Only other piece of advice is when you do the Aggro Crag on Advanced, take your time. This is classic NES/SNES platforming in a few spots where you can't see what is ahead of you off the screen.

subject: Aggro Crag
text: Falling to the bottom while halfway up is very painful, but the commenter says the timer is pretty generous.

evidence.quote: But falling to the bottom when you are halfway up is insanely painful. But the timer for this is pretty generous.

subject: Basic Training, Tornado Run, Aggro Crag
text: The commenter says Basic Training, Tornado Run and Aggro Crag are fun to optimize despite movement jank.

evidence.quote: but Basic Training, Tornado Run and Aggro Crag can be fun to optimize despite some jank movement.

subject: Aerial Challenges
text: The commenter considers the aerial events somewhat redundant.

evidence.quote: The aerial events are kinda redundant
